Card Q&A.a: 1 blue Digimon card and 1 green Digimon card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
If BT8-053 [Lighdramon] and P-117 [Veemon] are revealed by this card's [On Play] effect, can I choose BT8-053 [Lighdramon] to add as the blue card but choose to not add P-117 [Veemon] to my hand?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 memory or less, set your memory to 3.
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 blue and 1 green Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
